Details: ModularForm[id] is a handle to a registered modular form; aliases of one ID observe its validated updates (coefficients, expansions), and properties are read with y["Property"].

Each record holds its frozen context, the actual representation and basis, weight, definition, expression, value, q-expansion, coefficient and normalization record, validation evidence and provenance; the group is provenance only.
ModularForm.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; Head[First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]]]

Details: CreateModularForm[c, irrep, k, definition] creates a modular form of weight k for the irrep of the frozen context c from a ModularFormDefinition. Shape, the accepted representation and admissibility (rho(S^2) = e^{i Pi k}; for integer k the parity (-1)^k) are checked; modularity is not claimed (status Unverified).

The weight k is an exact rational. The convention is F(-1/tau) = (-tau)^k rho(S) F(tau), F(tau + 1) = rho(T) F(tau), with the principal branch of (-tau)^k. An SL(2,Z) quotient (rho(S^2) = +-1) admits integer weights only; a group with S^2 central and (ST)^3 = S^4 (for example Z_24 = <T> with S = T^3, which carries eta of weight 1/2) admits the weights k0 + 2Z with e^{i Pi k0} = rho(S^2). Rational-weight forms are user supplied (ConstructModularForms covers SL(2,Z) quotients).
A coefficient-free definition keeps its written scale (NoNormalizationNeeded); a parameterized one gets an anchor by the manual policy or the Normalization option. Available at every dimension.
CreateModularForm.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; ModularFormWeight[CreateModularForm[g, one, 4, ModularFormDefinition[{2 ScalarModularExpression["E4", q]}, q]]]]

Details: ModularFormData[y] gives the immutable record snapshot of the modular form y; later updates of y do not change a snapshot.
ModularFormData.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; ModularFormData[First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]]["Validation"]["Status"]]

Details: ModularFormRep[y] gives the actual frozen representation of the modular form y (not a live group lookup).
ModularFormRep.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; ModularFormRep[First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]] === GroupRepresentation[g, d]]

Details: ModularFormWeight[y] gives the weight of the modular form y, an exact rational (an integer for every form of an SL(2,Z) quotient).
ModularFormWeight.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; ModularFormWeight[First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]]]

Details: ModularFormExpression[y] gives the component expressions of y with its resolved coefficients; with unresolved coefficients it gives Missing["UnresolvedCoefficients", ids] (no coefficient is set to one). Option ApplyCoefficients.
ModularFormExpression.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; Length[ModularFormExpression[First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]], ApplyCoefficients -> False]]]

Details: ModularFormValue[y] gives the computational recipe of y: <|"Kind", "Coordinate", "Components"|> (or the finite jet) with resolved coefficients. Option ApplyCoefficients.
ModularFormValue.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; ModularFormValue[CreateModularForm[g, one, 4, ModularFormDefinition[{ScalarModularExpression["E4", q]}, q]]]["Kind"]]

Details: ModularFormCoefficients[y] gives the coefficient and normalization record of y: Kind ("Anchor" or "NoNormalizationNeeded"), Rules (Missing["Unresolved"] before solving), ProofStatus, and the anchor frame, family, component, exponent and value.
ModularFormCoefficients.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; ModularFormCoefficients[First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]]["Kind"]]

Details: ConstructModularForms[c, irrep] gives the ordered list of generating forms the recipe for the irrep supplies: Eta1D, Hypergeometric2D, Hypergeometric3D (v1's analytic recipes in certified exponents), Cyclic4D, NonCyclic4D (F and G) and Coupled5D (F and G, profile k0 + {0, 2, 2, 4, 6}).

Recipes are built in an exact temporary T-diagonal frame and transported to the stored basis; leading exponents and MLDE residuals are checked; relative normalization is left unresolved (ModularFormGetCoeff). Beyond the recipes the result is UnsupportedConstruction, also for an irrep with rho(S)^4 != I (a cover of SL(2,Z), rational weights: supply the forms with CreateModularForm). Options Method and SeriesOrder.
DiagonalizationMethod (Automatic, "Exact" or "NumericalReconstruction") chooses how the construction frame's T is diagonalized.
ConstructModularForms.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; Map[ModularFormWeight, ConstructModularForms[g, d]]]

Details: CoefficientResult[data] is the immutable report of a normalization solve: Rules, NumericFit, ExactCandidates, the anchor (Normalization), Evidence (rank, residuals, orders, samples, holdouts) and ProofStatus ("NumericalFit", "NumericallyCheckedReconstruction", "NumericallyCheckedExplicitRules" or "NumericalExplicitRules" for explicit NormalizationRules, "NotApplicable"; "Proven" only from an exact identity).

No implemented route produces Proven at present (there is no exact identity certificate, and the S check is sampled), so RequireProof -> True currently refuses every form and model result with ProofRequired.
CoefficientResult.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; Head[SolveModularCoefficients[g, one, 4, ModularFormDefinition[{ScalarModularExpression["E4", q]}, q]]]]

Details: SolveModularCoefficients[c, r, k, definition] fits the relative-normalization unknowns of a raw definition of weight k for the representation r (a Rep bound to c, or an irrep ID) and returns a CoefficientResult; nothing is changed.

The unknowns must occur linearly; the S-transformation law is sampled at independent points with an exact anchor row, rank and stability are checked, and algebraic proposals are verified at doubled precision on holdout points.

An explicit Method -> "Reconstruct" fails with ReconstructionRejected when no exact candidate passes the checks (the numerical fit is attached under "NumericalFit"); Method -> Automatic returns the numerical fit in that case.
SolveModularCoefficients.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; SolveModularCoefficients[g, one, 4, ModularFormDefinition[{ScalarModularExpression["E4", q] + c (ScalarModularExpression["E4", q]^3 - ScalarModularExpression["E6", q]^2)}, q, NormalizationParameters -> {c}], WorkingPrecision -> 30]["ExactCandidates"][[1, 2]]]

Details: ModularFormGetCoeff[y] resolves the relative-normalization coefficients of y with SolveModularCoefficients' method and commits them atomically (aliases see it); it returns y, and a Failure leaves y unchanged.
A coupled G is solved through its frozen companion F recipe; a derivative through its source recipe and anchor. A coefficient-free form is a no-op. Options as SolveModularCoefficients.

An explicit Method -> "Reconstruct" fails with ReconstructionRejected when no exact candidate passes the checks (the numerical fit is attached under "NumericalFit"); Method -> Automatic returns the numerical fit in that case.
ModularFormGetCoeff.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; Module[{y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]}, ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30]; Values[y["Coefficients"]["Rules"]]]]

Details: Option of the coefficient solvers: explicit coefficient values, checked through the same evidence path (holdout transformation residuals and the anchor).

Automatic (default: fit) or rules (or an association) from every parameter ID to a value; incomplete rules fail with InvalidOption and wrong values with InconsistentNormalization; checked exact rules report ProofStatus "NumericallyCheckedExplicitRules" (inexact ones "NumericalExplicitRules").
NormalizationRules.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; Module[{y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]}, ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30, NormalizationRules -> Thread[Lookup[y["Definition"]["Parameters"], "ID"] -> {-24}]]; y["Coefficients"]["ProofStatus"]]]

Details: Option of the coefficient solvers and ValidateModularForm: whether only a proof is acceptable.
False (default) or True: a result that is not Proven (numerical fits, verified reconstructions, sampled checks) fails with ProofRequired.

No implemented route produces Proven at present (there is no exact identity certificate, and the S check is sampled), so RequireProof -> True currently refuses every form and model result with ProofRequired.
RequireProof.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; FailureQ[ModularFormGetCoeff[First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]], RequireProof -> True]]]
